# Action reference

<!-- generated by scripts/gen-docs.ts, do not edit by hand (just docs-gen) -->

Every action is a chat command (`!name args`), an LLM tool and a typed call (`agent.act(name, params)`).
Positional chat arguments follow the parameter order below; `key=value` works too.

19 skills, 63 actions.

## building

Placing blocks.

### `place_block`

Place a block from the inventory at x y z. Needs a solid block next to that spot to build against.

*aliases: `place`*

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `item` | string | yes |  | block item to place, e.g. cobblestone |
| `x` | number | yes |  |  |
| `y` | number | yes |  |  |
| `z` | number | yes |  |  |

### `break_block`

Break (mine) the block at x y z with the best tool in the inventory (crafts a pickaxe first for stone and ores when it can). Needs digging enabled. Refuses chests and other containers unless force=true.

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | integer (-9007199254740991..9007199254740991) | yes |  |  |
| `y` | integer (-9007199254740991..9007199254740991) | yes |  |  |
| `z` | integer (-9007199254740991..9007199254740991) | yes |  |  |
| `force` | boolean |  | `false` | also break containers (chests, barrels...) |

## combat

Fighting hostile mobs, guarding players and hunting animals for food.

### `attack`

Fight the nearest hostile mob, or a specific entity by id.

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entityId` | number |  |  | entity id; default nearest hostile mob |
| `radius` | number |  | `16` |  |

### `guard`

Stay near a player and kill hostile mobs that come close to them, until stopped.

*long-running*

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `player` | string |  |  | player to protect; defaults to the requesting player |
| `radius` | number |  | `12` |  |

### `defend`

Fight back against whatever hostile mob is closest (used by reflexes).

*internal*

No parameters.

### `retreat`

Back off from nearby hostile mobs (used by reflexes at low health).

*internal*

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `distance` | number (6..32) |  | `18` |  |

### `hunt`

Hunt passive animals (cow, pig, sheep, chicken, rabbit, mooshroom) for food and pick up the drops. Never touches pets, named, tamed or leashed animals, babies, villagers or players, and by default leaves fenced animals alone.

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `animal` | `cow` \| `pig` \| `sheep` \| `chicken` \| `rabbit` \| `mooshroom` |  |  | which animal; default the nearest huntable one |
| `count` | integer (1..8) |  | `1` | how many to kill |
| `radius` | number (4..64) |  | `24` | how far to look, in blocks |
| `pens` | boolean |  | `false` | also hunt animals inside fences (only your own farm) |
| `keepAtLeast` | integer (0..32) |  | `0` | leave at least this many adults of each kind alive (sustainable herd) |

## construction

Building structures from blueprints.

### `build`

Build a whole structure from a blueprint. For "build a house" use small_house (cozy 5x5 wooden house: log corners, pitched stair roof, windows, door, torches, crafting table, chest, bed if there is wool). Others: cottage (bigger 7x7 house on a cobblestone foundation with porch, glass windows, furnace), cabin (log cabin), watchtower (ladder, fenced platform), fortress (15x15 walled compound to put a house in), hut (plain box, quick), shelter (emergency 3x3 box around the bot), wall_segment, platform, tower. Picks a flat, clear spot near whoever asked (never in protected areas or over player builds), fills small dips, digs bumps and plants, faces the door to the player (or an open side), places blocks with the right facing (stairs, slabs, logs, doors, torches...), checks every block afterwards and fixes mistakes, and skips blocks that are already right, so calling it again resumes an interrupted build. gather=true first gathers what is missing. Reports blocks built and what was skipped.

*long-running*

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `template` | string | yes |  | blueprint name: small_house (default house), cottage, cabin, watchtower, fortress, hut, shelter, wall_segment, platform, tower (build_plan lists all) |
| `x` | number |  |  | centre of the footprint; omit to pick a spot near the player |
| `y` | number |  |  | level of the floor (layer 0); default the ground there + 1 |
| `z` | number |  |  |  |
| `facing` | `north` \| `east` \| `south` \| `west` |  |  | side the entrance faces; default towards the player |
| `material` | string |  |  | main block, e.g. spruce_planks or cobblestone; default whatever fits that the bot has most of |
| `theme` | string |  |  | wood to build with: oak, spruce, birch, jungle, acacia, dark_oak, mangrove, cherry, pale_oak; default whatever wood the bot has most of |
| `gather` | boolean |  | `false` | gather missing materials first (chop trees, mine, craft) |
| `path` | boolean |  | `true` | dig a short dirt path from the door afterwards when the bot can make a shovel |

### `build_plan`

What a blueprint needs vs what the bot carries, and where it would go. preview=true adds a text drawing (top view and every layer). Without a template, lists the blueprints.

*non-exclusive*

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `template` | string |  |  |  |
| `material` | string |  |  |  |
| `theme` | string |  |  | wood to build with: oak, spruce, birch, jungle, acacia, dark_oak, mangrove, cherry, pale_oak; default whatever wood the bot has most of |
| `x` | number |  |  |  |
| `y` | number |  |  |  |
| `z` | number |  |  |  |
| `facing` | `north` \| `east` \| `south` \| `west` |  |  |  |
| `preview` | boolean |  | `false` | include a text drawing of the structure |

## crafting

Crafting and smelting.

### `craft`

Craft an item from what is in the inventory. Uses a crafting table within 16 blocks when the recipe needs one, or puts one down (from the inventory, or made from planks).

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `item` | string | yes |  | item to make, e.g. stick, crafting_table, stone_pickaxe |
| `count` | integer (1..256) |  | `1` | how many items to end up with (not recipe runs) |

### `smelt`

Smelt items in a furnace within 32 blocks (or one placed from the inventory), add fuel, wait and take the results.

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `item` | string | yes |  | item to smelt, e.g. raw_iron, sand, oak_log |
| `count` | integer (1..64) |  | `1` |  |
| `fuel` | string |  |  | fuel item; default the best one in the inventory (coal, charcoal, planks, logs...) |

## food

Food self-sufficiency: scouting for animals and village farms, starting a farm of its own, breeding animals.

### `find_food`

Scout for food beyond what is in sight: first known food spots, then an expanding spiral around home (or here) out to `radius` blocks, by day, avoiding water, lava and protected areas, until it sees huntable animals or a village farm. Remembers what it finds as places (food:animals, food:village_farm, food:water). Does not hunt; use hunt or keep_fed after.

*long-running*

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `radius` | number (32..512) |  | `200` | how far from home to scout, in blocks |
| `atNight` | boolean |  | `false` | also scout at night (dangerous) |
| `animals` | array |  | `["cow","pig","sheep","chicken","rabbit","mooshroom"]` | animals that count as food |
| `crops` | boolean |  | `true` | village farms (crops with villagers nearby) count as food too |
| `maxMinutes` | number (1..30) |  | `8` | give up after this long |
| `keepAtLeast` | integer (0..32) |  | `0` | only count animals above this many adults of a kind (a herd to spare) |
| `from` | `home` \| `here` |  | `"home"` | centre of the search: home (when set) or where the bot stands |

### `start_farm`

Start a small farm of its own: picks grass or dirt by water near home (or a place), outside protected areas and away from anybody's builds or fields (or pours water from a bucket), then gets seeds by breaking grass (or uses carrots, potatoes, beetroot seeds), makes a hoe if needed, tills a plot around the water, plants it, fences and lights it if it has the materials, and remembers it as farm:1, farm:2... for farm_loop/farm_setup. Needs digging enabled.

*long-running*

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `place` | string |  |  | remembered place (or home) to farm near; default home, else here |
| `x` | number |  |  | farm near this x (with z) instead |
| `z` | number |  |  |  |
| `size` | integer (3..9) |  | `9` | plot side, odd, around one water block (9 = 80 farmland) |
| `radius` | number (8..96) |  | `48` | how far from the centre to look for water |
| `seeds` | integer (1..64) |  | `10` | seeds to collect before planting (breaks grass until it has them or gives up) |
| `fence` | boolean |  | `true` | fence the plot when it has (or can craft) enough fences |
| `light` | boolean |  | `true` | put torches on the corners when it has torches or coal |
| `spawnClearance` | number (0..256) |  | `48` | never farm within this distance of the world spawn |

### `breed`

Breed two adult animals of a kind it sees (cows/sheep with wheat, pigs with carrots/potatoes/beetroot, chickens with seeds), leading them towards its farm first when it has one nearby. Never feeds pets, named, leashed or fenced animals that are not on its own farm. Keeps seeds for replanting.

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `animal` | `cow` \| `mooshroom` \| `sheep` \| `pig` \| `chicken` \| `rabbit` |  |  | which kind; default the best one it has food for |
| `radius` | number (4..48) |  | `24` | how far to look for animals |
| `lure` | boolean |  | `true` | lead them to its farm first (when one is within 64 blocks) |
| `keepSeeds` | integer (0..64) |  | `8` | seeds to keep for replanting |
| `maxHerd` | integer (2..64) |  | `12` | do not breed a kind with this many adults around |

## materials

Gathering and crafting everything a job needs.

### `gather_materials`

Get the materials for a job in one go: chops as many trees as needed (crafting a wooden axe first), turns logs into planks and sticks, crafts wooden items (stairs, slabs, fences, doors, trapdoors, ladders, crafting tables, chests, tools), mines cobblestone with a pickaxe and other simple blocks, and tries for the extras: torches (coal, or charcoal smelted from logs), glass panes (sand smelted into glass), a bed (wool from sheep nearby). Extras it can't get are skipped and reported. Give either items, e.g. {"planks": 80, "door": 1} ("planks", "log", "door", "stairs", "slab", "fence", "bed" mean any wood/colour), or template="small_house" for everything a blueprint needs. Prefer this over many chop_tree/craft calls. Needs digging enabled to chop or mine.

*long-running*

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | object |  |  | item -> count, e.g. {"oak_planks": 64, "stick": 8, "door": 1} |
| `template` | string |  |  | blueprint name (see build_plan) to gather everything it needs |
| `material` | string |  |  | with template: the main block to use, e.g. spruce_planks or cobblestone |
| `theme` | string |  |  | wood to build with: oak, spruce, birch, dark_oak...; default whatever wood the bot has most of |
| `radius` | integer (8..64) |  | `32` | how far to look for trees and blocks |

Exact item/block/mob names a mod adds on this server, optionally filtered by a search word (e.g. mod=create query=press). Use these names in explanations and with creative_get.

No parameters.

### `sleep`

Sleep in a bed within 16 blocks (only works at night or during storms).

No parameters.

### `wake`

Get out of bed.

No parameters.

### `pillar`

Emergency escape: jump and place blocks underneath to stand on a pillar out of reach of mobs. Uses dirt/cobblestone/planks from the inventory.

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `height` | integer (1..8) |  | `3` | how many blocks to rise |
| `item` | string |  |  | block to use; default the most plentiful dirt/cobblestone/planks |

### `climb_out`

Get out of a pit, shaft or cave straight up to open sky: dig the block above if needed, jump and place a block underneath, repeat. Without blocks it carves stair steps up into the wall instead.

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `maxBlocks` | integer (1..64) |  | `32` | give up after rising this many blocks |

### `bunker`

Hide from phantoms and other mobs: dig straight down 3 blocks, seal the hole above with a dug block, wait until morning (or until no hostiles are near), then climb out. Needs digging; not in protected areas.

*long-running*

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `depth` | integer (2..4) |  | `3` |  |
| `maxMinutes` | number (0.5..15) |  | `8` | give up waiting after this long |
| `untilDay` | boolean |  | `true` | stay until morning instead of until mobs leave |

## woodcutting

Felling trees.

### `chop_tree`

Fell the nearest natural tree (any wood type): cut the logs it can reach, pick up the drops and plant a sapling. Crafts a wooden axe first if there is none and the inventory has the wood. Needs digging enabled. For "get N planks/logs" or materials for a build, prefer gather_materials, which chops as many trees as needed.

*aliases: `chop`*

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `radius` | number (4..64) |  | `32` | how far to look for a tree, in blocks |
| `replant` | boolean |  | `true` | plant a sapling of the same kind afterwards if the bot has one |
| `make_axe` | boolean |  | `true` | craft a wooden axe first when there is none and there is wood for it |

## behaviors (brain)

Registered by `behaviorsBrain()`, see [Behaviours](../guide/behaviors.md).

### `behavior_list`

List the behaviours this bot can arm: armed behaviours keep running on their own between your turns (keep_fed finds and eats food, stay_safe backs off at low health, follow_owner, guard_area, farm_loop...). Pass a name for its options and defaults.

*non-exclusive*

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  |  | one behaviour to explain in detail |

### `behavior_status`

Show which behaviours are armed, their options, what is running now, last outcomes and cooldowns.

*non-exclusive*

No parameters.

### `behavior_arm`

Arm a behaviour so it keeps running on its own, without further turns, until disarmed (it survives restarts). Arm keep_fed so you look after your own food, stay_safe to back off at low health, follow_owner or guard_owner to stay with your owner, guard_area to defend a spot, farm_loop / chop_wood_loop for ongoing chores. Prefer this over doing an ongoing job turn by turn.

*non-exclusive*

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |  | behaviour name from behavior_list, e.g. keep_fed |
| `options` | any |  |  | options as an object, e.g. {"below": 10}; in chat as key=value pairs, e.g. below=10 animals=cow,pig |

### `behavior_disarm`

Switch an armed behaviour off (stops it now if it is running). It stays off across restarts.

*non-exclusive*

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |  | behaviour name from behavior_list, e.g. keep_fed |

### `behavior_configure`

Change the options of a behaviour (armed or not) without arming or disarming it, e.g. keep_fed below=10.

*non-exclusive*

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |  | behaviour name from behavior_list, e.g. keep_fed |
| `options` | any |  |  | options as an object, e.g. {"below": 10}; in chat as key=value pairs, e.g. below=10 animals=cow,pig |

### `behavior_reset`

Forget runtime arm/disarm/configure changes and go back to the profile's behaviours (one, or all without a name).

*non-exclusive*

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  |  | behaviour to reset; default all |
